title: DeFi total value locked reaches new milestone despite market
content: TL;DR: While decentralized finance (DeFi) platforms report new milestones in total value locked, the bedrock of digital sovereignty, Bitcoin, continues its relentless, self-regulating operation. Today's network metrics reveal a robust, albeit slightly moderated, hashpower securing block 934,820, with an anticipated downward adjustment in difficulty offering potential relief for miners. This divergence underscores the fundamental difference between speculative financial innovation and the unyielding, trustless monetary base layer Bitcoin provides.
author: Al Ingle
